description:
T1. Conifer Tree. 5 metres in width. 5 metres in height. Cut back and reshape by 1.5 metres. The tree is very overgrown and taking up most of neighbours garden as it is growing from next door, also needs to be made to look tidy as it is also growing over garages. Situated in the rear garden of number 24.
T2. Hawthorne Bush. 6 metres in height. 5 metres in width. Lift and cut leaders by 1.5 metres in order to form shape. The bush is very overgrown and taking up most of the neighbours garden as it is growing from next door, also need to be made to look tidy as it is intwining with the other bushes/shrubs. Situated in the rear garden of number 24. 
T11. T12. Laurel hedge. Reduce and reshape. Trim away from the houses. as it is very overgrown and touching the building. Situated down the side of the building of number 10.
application_type_full: Tree works: Trees in conservation areas/subject to TPOs
decision_conditions: The proposed work is to be carried out to British Standard 3998 (2010) Tree Work Recommendations, by a reputable tree surgeon to the satisfaction of the Tree Preservation Officer who should be informed of the date of commencement of work.
